blocks.heading: Questions
blocks.text: What this example shows, and what it leaves out.

questions.question: Where does the content come from?
questions.answer: From a small HTTP server in this package. It reads the pages from JSON files and serves a paged list and a list of changes.

questions.question: Can I use my own CMS?
questions.answer: Yes. Copy the loader and change the two requests it makes to the ones your CMS answers.

questions.question: Why does this page ship JavaScript?
questions.answer: The accordion you are reading is interactive, so the page loads its code. The home page does not.
